title: Systems and automation in Prescott, AZ | Creosote Labs
meta_description: Systems and automation for Prescott businesses. We consolidate spreadsheets into one system, build internal tools, and automate data entry and follow-up.
intro: Businesses in Prescott include hospitals and medical practices, hotels and restaurants serving visitors, contractors, property managers, and downtown shops. Many of them track work in a mix of Excel or Google Sheets, QuickBooks, and a field or booking tool such as ServiceTitan, AppFolio, or Square, with the gaps between those systems filled by re-typing. Scheduling, quoting, job tracking, and month-end reporting are the areas where that re-typing accumulates.

Creosote Labs consolidates those spreadsheets and disconnected tools into a single system of record for businesses in Prescott and the surrounding area. Engagements begin with a one-day operations review at $3,000, which produces a written assessment and a fixed quote for each recommendation. From there we build the internal tools the business needs, automate the repetitive steps, document the result, and hand it over to staff.
projects: A single job board that replaces a roofing company's 3 scheduling spreadsheets and pushes completed jobs into QuickBooks.
A work-order tracker for a property management company that logs tenant requests, assigns vendors, and records the invoice against the unit.
An automated follow-up sequence that emails a quote, reminds the customer after 3 days, and flags the office when a quote goes unanswered.
A monthly reporting tool that pulls sales from Square and labor from the scheduling system into one owner's report.
An intake form for a physical therapy clinic that creates the patient record and the first appointment in one step.
A parts and inventory sheet for an auto repair shop that reorders automatically when stock drops below a set level.

faqs.q: Does a Prescott business have to replace QuickBooks or its booking software?
faqs.a: Usually not. Projects typically keep the accounting and booking tools already in use and connect them, replacing only the spreadsheets and manual steps in between.

faqs.q: What happens to the existing spreadsheet data?
faqs.a: We import it into the new system during implementation and check it against the originals before staff switch over. Nothing is discarded until the business confirms the new records are correct.

faqs.q: How is a systems project priced?
faqs.a: The operations review is $3,000 and includes a fixed quote for each recommended system. Implementation is priced from that quote, with no hourly billing, and the review fee is credited toward implementation that begins within 90 days.
